findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Your library. Every screen." (screen 1, 100% over a picture); "Every screen." (screen 1, 100% over a picture); "Your films sit in folders." (screen 2, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.
